title: The Sheer Scale of It
gist_ar: نص بيستخدم مبالغات كتير: الكاتب بيحلّل إزاي التشديد بيقنع من غير أدلة.
text:
The campaign material is remarkably consistent. The need is "utterly urgent",
the current provision "nowhere near adequate", the proposal "by far the most
effective option available". I do appreciate the sincerity behind this. I also
notice that not one of those three phrases contains a number.

Intensification is not deception, and it would be downright unfair to suggest
otherwise. Where a writer is thoroughly familiar with a subject and profoundly
convinced, emphatic language is the natural register, and prose that refuses it
altogether reads as evasive. Far too much professional writing is flattened by a
fear of seeming committed.

But emphasis substitutes for evidence with unusual ease, and it does so all the
more effectively because it is not a claim. "Considerably worse" cannot be
checked. "Worse by eleven per cent" can, and is markedly less persuasive, which
is decidedly the point. A reader who asks what "vastly" means is treated as
pedantic, and a writer who avoids the word is thought weak. The incentives run
one way.

What did happen — and this is the part the material does state plainly, once, in
a footnote — is that provision fell by six per cent over four years. That is a
real decline. It is distinctly less than the text implies, and it is beyond doubt
enough to justify the proposal on its own.

Which is what makes the rhetoric self-defeating. The case is sound. By
underscoring it with language that cannot be verified, the campaign has made a
verifiable argument look like an unverifiable one, and has invited the only
rebuttal that was ever available: not that the need is small, but that the people
describing it were unwilling to say how large.

questions.q: What is the writer's overall verdict on the campaign?
questions.q_ar: إيه حكم الكاتب النهائي على الحملة؟
options: The case is weak and the rhetoric conceals it
The case and the rhetoric are both effective
The case is sound but the rhetoric has damaged it

questions.q: What does the writer concede about emphatic language?
questions.q_ar: الكاتب بيقرّ بإيه عن لغة التشديد؟
options: It is the natural register of genuine conviction, and prose without it reads evasive

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'worse by eleven per cent' is less persuasive?
questions.q_ar: ليه 'أسوأ بـ11 في المية' أقل إقناعًا؟
options: It can be checked, and that is precisely the point

questions.q: What rebuttal does the writer say the campaign has invited?
questions.q_ar: إيه الردّ اللي الحملة فتحت الباب له؟
options: That those describing the need would not say how large it was
